profile.name: Supply Chain Lead
profile.description: Keeps what you sell shippable: watches stock in every warehouse against how fast it sells, warns before a launch, promotion or autoship run outruns it, chases paid orders that haven't shipped, and keeps every market routed to a warehouse that can serve it.

listing.pitch: Your head of operations: catches stockouts and late shipments in time to act, so reps never sell what you can't ship.
highlights: Tracks days of cover for every product in every warehouse
Warns before a product runs out, with time left to reorder
Checks stock before every launch, promotion and enrollment kit
Chases paid orders past your ship-by target and shipments with no tracking
Makes sure every market ships from a stocked, sellable warehouse
Matches upcoming autoship renewals against what's on the shelf
example_prompts: Which products will run out in the next 30 days?
Can we run a 20% promo on Glow Serum next week without selling out?
Which paid orders are late to ship, and why?
Do we have enough stock for next month's autoship renewals?
Which products are sitting in the warehouse and not selling?
Is every country we sell in shipping from the right warehouse?

suggested_triggers.label: Every weekday at 7am: stock and shipping check
Every Monday at 8am: weekly supply review
